notes: 28 scenes at reading pace; the etymology VALUE→SOLVE circuit, the X=x six views, the number evolution, the torus quilt, the Śaiva six turns, the gathered cross-register table, and the Night-pass Name/Power sequences all run as step sequences; music scenes stage the two chromatic substrates, the pairing families, the twelve lens anchors, the CF selection, the 84/144 fields and the V–I observer loop. Scene bodies carry bare tokens (backtick marks dropped as an essay-surface convention; see logics binding).

Per-scene moves (2026-10-06 enrichment): the four files are one derivation reread four times, so every scene's sequence walks its file's own chain with objectState marking the turns — blue at inverse/contrast steps, gold at the earned arrival (which also swells the glyph ~6-8%). def-the-matheme: "I see x" walks to 4+2 = 5→0 under a gentle linear morph; the sentence is the unit. def-minus-over-minus: vortex pointer, the slash's two offices separated then joined. def-copula: = → ≠ → the expansion → 4+2 = 6. def-harmonics-and-recount: the recount chain with 3:3 crossing marked. def-six-determinations: the mandala table under mild attract forces, parent repel and return attract. def-catuskoti-crossing: the tetralemma walked as a six-step sequence (IS, IS-NOT, BOTH, NEITHER, SILENCE gold), corners forced apart by repel/attract — turbulence LFO is the held tension. def-immutable-subject: the three pairs laminated through z. proc-t1-geometry: THE 3D SCENE — the phase wheel with 00/01/10/11 lifted alternately ±z around the centre (bevel volume, perspective): AND/OR arranged around a clock the slash turns. proc-phase-flip: F/R(F) alternate 180° objectState rotations under a negative thetaRate morph — the flip as operation. proc-t0-onto-logic: the four parents gathered under one slow morph clock. proc-spanda: the equation sequence through T₀/T₁ to the standing unity. proc-ratio-threshold: the cymatic ladder (240/320/360/480) under an ascending resonanceDrive with a ±8 Hz LFO — the never-settling tick. proc-harmonics-symmetries: forward folds attract, complementary folds repel. proc-ql-positions: the crosswalk ring at low pointer strength. quilt-etymology: VALUE→SOLVE six-stage chain. quilt-psychology: X/x chain under a 'beat' morph with equal rates — X and x as near-twins. quilt-number: sums to the perfect count, red at the ±0 gate, gold at the modular return. quilt-topology: the winding sequence displaces position (lift ends displaced — the retained displacement), toroidal morph gentle. quilt-metaphysics: the tattvic ladder walked. quilt-recognition: the proof gathered under implode. quilt-enantiodromic-return: Name and Power runs tint alternately (truth/play crossing), 'beat' law with opposed rate signs. music-foundational-ratios: pingpong resonanceDrive over the ratio circuit, ±12 Hz LFO. music-chromatic-substrates: the two whole-tone sets repel (kept distinct), shove marks the comma's refusal. music-pairing-grammar: the three pairings attract mildly. music-lens-anchors: the lens ring under vortex. music-diatonic-cf-grammar: the seven degrees in a gentle attract line at 320 Hz. music-field: the 84/144 test sequence proves the correspondence by exhaustion (gold at '48 none'). music-observer-instrument: the slowest scene (16 s), pingpong sweep and triangle excitation LFO — listening as return.

Craft: pointer profiles by meaning across the 28 scenes — attract/pulse for derivations read forward, attract/implode where the relation gathers (t0 parents, recognition, ratios, number), vortex for the slash and winding scenes (minus-over-minus, phase-flip, t1 wheel, quilt-topology, lens anchors), repel where offices or positions must stay distinct (catuṣkoṭi corners, chromatic sets, shove at the comma), near-still low strengths for the contemplative plates (six-determinations 0.9, crosswalk 0.95, observer 0.7). Automation lanes: dispersion breathing on def-the-matheme/proc-spanda/quilt-metaphysics/music-field, turbulence on the catuṣkoṭi crossing, circulation on quilt-topology, frequency LFOs on the two ratio ladders, triangle excitation on the observer. Durations 12/14/16 s and transitions 1.5/2.2/2.8 s differ across the journey. Claim-status bands ride every kicker unchanged; withholdings preserved (the crossed-zero full sequence still waits for its §4 scene; the comma stays exact).

What the third dimension means (proc-t1-geometry): T1's geometry is a clock of phases around a ground — the scene lifts the four ordered phases 00/01/10/11 alternately above and below the centre's plane (±0.25 z) inside a bevel-volume ring under perspective. Depth is the AND/OR fact: opposite phases stand on opposite sides of the ground, adjacent phases share a side, and the vortex pointer turns the wheel — the geometry of space-time as a phase arrangement the slash generates, not a picture of it.
